# Module M-01: Check that new orders reached the order sheet

## Lesson

You do this a few times a day, after purchase orders arrive. When it works, each order's lines are in the order sheet within 15 minutes, with the product codes in the LC-nnnn form. [SC-01]

## Exercise

In the test environment, with its test data:

1. Open the orders mailbox and see which purchase orders arrived. [SC-01 step 1]
2. Wait 15 minutes, then open the order sheet. [SC-01 step 2]
3. Check each order's lines against its purchase order. [SC-01 step 3]

## Check question

What do you do when it goes wrong?

## Answer

An order still missing after 15 minutes is on the exceptions list; settle it there. [map/future.md item 2]
